record.title: Working with the Home Office to measure innovation readiness and inform strategy
record.description: Based on the ISO 56000 standards for innovation management, and Sopra Steria’s experience of delivering innovation services across Europe, our assessment ensures a lightweight, insight-driven and action-oriented measure of innovation readiness. It considers six core elements ( context , culture , leadership , exploration, exploitation and support) through the assessment of over 30 different characteristics.

record.title: Making healthcare services more flexible
record.description: Hemit has a critical societal mission to operate and develop vital digital services for over 20,000 users within the specialist health service in Trøndelag and Møre og Romsdal 24 hours a day, all year round. They will strengthen the patient experience and the quality of management by ensuring that healthcare personnel have access to reliable, user-friendly and effective digital tools. Hemit is the link to all hospitals and health enterprises in Helse Midt-Norge. In order for the link to become even better, they will now collaborate with Sopra Steria to implement the ServiceNow platform as an important work tool.

record.title: Prioritising, modernising and protecting over 2,000 applications at Defra
record.description: Sopra Steria was appointed to support with the strategic Legacy Application Programme (LAP), a fast-paced, complex, multi-year programme of work addressing the legacy estate risks at DEFRA.

record.title: Sopra Steria creates digital support tool for UK Power Networks customers
record.description: After a 25-year collaborative partnership, Sopra Steria was chosen to deliver a crucial strategic project.

record.title: Accelerating innovative expansion using a strategic approach to Cloud technology
record.description: To achieve these critical objectives, Wallenius Wilhelmsen selected Sopra Steria as their chosen strategic partner, due to our expertise in Digital Platform Services Consulting and Managed Services. This collaboration started with an optimised migration of its 120 critical business workloads into the Cloud (Microsoft Azure and temporary Oracle Cloud). Sopra Steria worked alongside our client to define a six-month transformation plan. This started in 2020 and included a customised cloud evolution strategy for each application which applied a lift and shift and extend approach and development of the required business cases. Specific attention was also focused on the improvement of the existing landing zones with cutting-edge governance, observability and automation practices and tools.

record.title: How symmedia's cloud-based solution accelerates the service business in mechanical engineering
record.description: Instead of outsourcing development, Sopra Steria worked within the symmedia project team, providing 18 experts in full-stack development, UX design, solution architecture, operations engineering and project management. The project followed an Agile approach with bi-weekly Scrum cycles and was completed in just 18 months - a remarkable achievement for the complexity of the solution.

record.title: Aker BP: Nitro – a modern platform for agile development
record.description: Aker BP now has a modern development platform that ensures fast and agile development. The platform handles the entire release process in a safe manner from idea generation and development to production. This allows for significantly faster error correction and the development of new functionality. Developers can now deliver enhanced functionality directly to end users, regardless of limited IT operations capabilities or traditional change management.

record.title: The Agriculture Middleware Strategy passes its first inspection
record.description: After a 25-year collaborative partnership, Sopra Steria was chosen to deliver a crucial strategic project.

record.title: How Sopra Steria is supporting the digital transformation of ADIF railway stations
record.description: Sopra Steria is defining and developing a transformation roadmap, to turn passenger stations into 'smart' stations with a team of consultants including Business Strategy, Technology and Organisation, and Digital Acceleration.

record.title: Ein SAP BW Selfservice Datawarehouse für die Berufsgenossenschaft
record.description: Die Berufsgenossenschaft Rohstoffe und chemische Industrie (BG RCI) hat im Anschluss an die Fusion aus sechs einzelnen Berufsgenossenschaften ein SAP BW Selfservice Datawarehouse eingeführt. Die Anwender im Bereich Reporting & Analytics können nun eigenständig komplexe Auswertungen in kurzer Zeit erstellen. Davon profitieren auch die Versicherten des Unfallversicherungsträgers.

record.title: So profitiert Ferngasnetzbetreiber Bayernets vom System Gas-X
record.description: Die zentrale und kurzfristige Vermarktung von Transportkapazitäten in europäischen Hochdruckleitungen stellt hohe Ansprüche an die IT-Systeme der Ferngasnetzbetreiber. GAS-X integriert nahtlos die Prozesse von der Kapazitätsvermarktung bis zur Abrechnung. Die Neuordnung des nationalen Gasmarktes durch die Bundesnetzagentur (BNetzA) anhand einheitlicher Kapazitätsregelungen und zentraler Transportauktionen (KARLA Gas) erfordert von der bayernets GmbH extrem kurze Reaktionszeiten auf Buchungsanfragen und ein komplexes Kapazitätsmanagement. Der Fernleitungsbetreiber aus München suchte daher nach einer integrierten IT-Lösung für die Vermarktung von Gaskapazitäten inklusive aller Abwicklungs- und Abrechnungsprozesse.

record.title: The future of money has no age limit
record.description: Most payments work so smoothly that we barely notice them. Fraud changes that. Someone receives a convincing call from someone claiming to be their bank. There is urgency. Pressure. Just enough information to make the story believable. Suddenly, the invisible payment system becomes visible. When a suspected fraudulent payment is reported, systems need to identify what is happening and respond quickly. Sopra Steria is developing AI tooling to help banks handle more cases and respond faster. But the technology is not the story. The person on the other end is. Someone who has just discovered that their money may be at risk. Speed is not the performance. Speed is the protection.

record.title: Keeping water a source of joy
record.description: AI is often presented as something that should be deployed as quickly as possible. Waterschap Limburg has deliberately taken a different approach. First understand the traditional models. First prove that the foundations work. Then decide where AI can add value. It can accelerate routine calculations, support validation and combine established knowledge with probability. But in critical infrastructure, technology should be judged by the quality of the decisions it enables, not by the speed of the algorithm.

record.title: Free to get lost in the moment
record.description: The value of counter-drone technology is not how much complexity it can handle. It is how confidently the people responsible for safety can handle that complexity - while everyone else stays free to get lost in the moment.

record.title: Preparing Governance for the AI Era in an International Organisation
record.description: By strengthening governance and internal awareness, the organisation can continue adopting new technologies while maintaining the high standards of trust and accountability expected from an international organisation.

record.title: Transdev Nederland: your journey starts here
record.description: Transdev Netherlands is one of the largest mobility companies in the Netherlands. From buses, trains and taxis to ambulances and autonomous shuttles, Transdev vehicles can be found throughout the country. Transdev provides public transport, care transport, school transport and acute care under well-known brand names such as Transdev, Connexxion, Hermes and Witte Kruis. Transdev also contributes to the ecological transition and the protection of the environment through a rapid transition to zero-emission transport.

record.title: Navigating Innovation: Predictive Depth Model for Port of Antwerp-Bruges
record.description: To ensure ships can reach the port quickly and safely, and given the increasing trend towards giant ships with deeper draught – dredging is an essential activity at the Port of Antwerp-Bruges. Dredgers regularly remove sediments and debris from the bottom to maintain a constant depth and guarantee continuous nautical access to the port. It is a routine necessity in waterways around the world because sedimentation—the natural process of sand and silt settling down—gradually fills channels and harbors.

record.title: Fiera Milano improves its Customer Experience with Cloud Data solution
record.description: The company offers a high-standing experience, in safe, welcoming, and reliable spaces across its 399,000 m². Besides its unique exhibition capabilities, Fiera Milano has also embraced a “phygital” approach including its physical stores and its digital assets such as its websites, its apps, and its e-commerce sites. Fiera Milano is indeed committed to offer its exhibitors and visitors the greatest experience in terms of process efficiency, time to market, commercial approach effectiveness, and product quality.

record.title: TM Roco Tailors Cost Estimations and Optimises Operations for Oosterweel Junction
record.description: Building on its proven adaptation success, Etupri received recognition and approval from DEME and became the unanimous choice for implementation within the TM Roco project, addressing a critical segment of the Oosterweel junction. Central to the success story that it turned out to be today, was that the programme seamlessly translated the complex nature of the project into concrete calculations, highlighting Sopra Steria 's ability to meet the diverse needs of one of the city of Antwerp's most extensive and multifaceted construction projects.

record.title: Stater pursues real-time and advanced system integration with eConsumer platform.
record.description: To increase customer service and to further digitise and innovate, Stater required an online platform that allows consumers to track their loans and perform various self-service actions. At Stater, we handle sensitive customer information from different lenders, which must be kept strictly separated and processed with high-security standards. Therefore, we needed a partner who possesses the required experience and know-how to successfully complete such a project.

record.title: City of Mechelen easily manages its 20 sub-sites using cms eGo
record.description: In the past, the city of Mechelen relied too much on its cms to quickly solve certain technical problems. "We were wrong, because a cms is obviously not a database or a booking system," says Christophe. "Now we no longer waste time looking for temporary solutions and we can immediately integrate professional tools that fully meet our needs. A good example of this is that we can easily monitor our websites and detect errors in time. Moreover, Tobians Anton and Joke provide us with a lot of tips and best practices."

record.title: Ecopower improves cyber-maturity of organization
record.description: Ecopower recognizes the importance of and need for decent awareness training for each employee within its organization to better defend itself and its customers against cyber-attacks. Training employees lowers the probability that an adversary will be able to launch a successful attack, because the most witnessed entry-point still is a human being, tricked to expose information or allow an attacker to enter company premises or systems.

record.title: Semantic data modeling at the National Police
record.description: The National Police has an increasing amount of data available from various sources to carry out their tasks. Understanding the meaning of all this data and managing the complexity of integrating this data is becoming an ever-greater challenge. Observations in both the physical and digital domains, expressed in a lot of different ways, need to be aggregated into collective knowledge within the police force. This calls for a different way of organizing knowledge.

record.title: Royal FloraHolland implements SAP BRIM
record.description: This project entails the implementation of SAP BRIM, replacing the old tailormade invoicing channels, which had different types of invoices per client, with one synthesized invoice per customer. The auction process was optimized and streamlined, from clocking and validating bank guarantees to collecting with buyers and settling with growers. The online availability of financial information for growers and buyers is also a part of the solution. The VAT engine Vertex is integrated with Hybris Billing; Vertex helps FloraHolland with its international VAT challenges.

record.title: Enhancing detection at de Volksbank
record.description: The migration from RiskShield Investigator to RiskShield Application Center marked a significant step for De Volksbank in enhancing its fraud detection capabilities. The collaboration with Sopra Steria not only ensured a smooth transition but also introduced innovative features that positively impacted the efficiency of fraud analysts. The project’s success demonstrates the commitment of both parties to delivering impactful solutions that align with the organization’s goals. The upgraded platform now positions De Volksbank to conduct thorough investigations into fraud cases, contributing to the overall security of the bank and its clientele.

record.title: Øget overblik og oppetid hos Hovedstadens Beredskab
record.description: Hovedstadens Beredskab får ikke kun mere overblik og oppetid med Dynatrace Software Intelligence, men også Automatisering, hurtig implementering, AI-baseret problemløsning og automatiseret recovery.

record.title: Sopra Steria og Røde Kors moderniserer digital lektiehjælp for elever
record.description: Sopra Steria stod for udviklingen af Røde Kors’ nye lektiehjælp som er brugervenlig, skalérbar og driftssikker med chat, video og skærmdeling.

record.title: Procesautomatisering hos Hovedstadens Beredskab
record.description: Hovedstadens Beredskab fik automatiseret 16 processer og 6.006 arbejdsprocesser på 6 måneder med RPA svarende til 1 medarbejder på administrative områder som nu kan sættes på mere interessante opgaver

record.title: Trade Point: Minimerer antallet af systemer og omkostninger med Microsoft Dynamics 365
record.description: Med Microsoft Dynamics 365 kan Trade Point A/S nu håndtere alle deres kunder i ét samlet system og derved spare både tid, ressourcer og omkostninger på licenser samt på vedligehold.

record.title: Udvikling og implementering af ABAservice app
record.description: Vi har hjulpet Hovedstadens Beredskab med at udvikle en app, der gør, at serviceteknikere selv kan sætte et ABA-anlæg i service og retur i drift via en app og dermed mindske presset på vagtcentralen.

record.title: Efficienza, qualità e scalabilità: i risultati dell’AI nel ciclo applicativo di Credem
record.description: Anche la qualità della documentazione di progetto ha beneficiato della standardizzazione introdotta dall’AI, con output più omogenei, coerenti e facilmente leggibili. In parallelo, i team hanno potuto spostare il proprio impegno verso attività a maggiore valore aggiunto, riducendo il tempo dedicato a operazioni ripetitive e potenziando la capacità complessiva di risposta ai cambiamenti. Il progetto conferma che l’intelligenza artificiale è una leva già oggi capace di rendere i processi IT più scalabili, intelligenti e affidabili, rafforzando al tempo stesso la governance e il ruolo delle persone nel ciclo di sviluppo applicativo.

record.title: Faster, smarter local train movement planning with the ORMAS Portal
record.description: ProRail is responsible for managing thousands of local train movements across the Dutch railway network. These movements are essential for maintenance, logistics, and operational continuity. However, the planning and approval process for local train movements was highly manual and time-consuming. Planners often had to wait several days – or even weeks - for approvals, relying on fragmented systems and manual coordination. This created delays, reduced flexibility, and placed unnecessary pressure on planners, crews, and operations, at a time when speed and coordination are critical for passenger, freight and crew.

record.title: Vattenfall utvecklar framtidens system för fysisk elhandel
record.description: Tillsammans utvecklade Vattenfall och Sopra Sterias designteam Power Planner – ett nytt digitalt system för planering och hantering av fysisk elhandel. Arbetet drevs genom ett användarcentrerat utvecklingssätt genom intervjuer, prototypframtagning och löpande tester med olika kundsegment. Vi kunde då säkerställde vi att lösningen mötte både marknadens och användarnas behov. Projektet startade under hög tidspress och med många parallella krav. För att kunna leverera i tid valde teamet att fokusera på en tydlig MVP-strategi (Minimum Viable Product). Varje funktion vägdes mot behov, verksamhetens mål och tekniska förutsättningar för att säkerställa att utvecklingen fokuserade på det som skapade störst värde. Redan fyra månader efter projektstart lanserades en första MVP-version. Därefter följde en stegvis utrullning till olika marknader och kundgrupper fram till den fulla övergången inför EU-reglernas ikraftträdande. Parallellt etablerades även gemensamma designprinciper och komponenter för Vattenfalls företagsportaler, vilket bidrog till en mer enhetlig digital kundupplevelse.
